# IRocket.HomingStrength property

How sharply it turns toward its target now: its runner's [`HomingStrength`](../IRocketRules/HomingStrength.md) when fired, growing by [`HomingGrowth`](./HomingGrowth.md) each second while it has a target. 0 does not turn it.
